text.question: What would make this idea useful on a difficult first day, when the person using it has little time, an unreliable connection, a long list of unfinished work, and needs to understand the next step without losing the notes they already wrote?
text.answer: I want a calm place to keep the names, questions and small details from conversations. It should work with a long answer and leave the original words intact, including a deliberatelyunbrokentokenxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx.
chips: Help someone find the one next step in a long list without losing their original notes.
Keep the useful details on this device so an unreliable connection does not erase them.
Make the question easy to read with enlarged text and a narrow window.
text.markdown:
## Task
Build a calm, local-first notebook. Preserve the user's words.

## First-day workflow
1. Open the current idea.
2. Add the next useful detail.
3. Copy the complete markdown when ready.

| Situation | Recovery |
| --- | --- |
| No connection | Keep the local transcript |
| Save failed | Export before closing |

## Example
```js
const note = { title: "A long idea", source: "<script>not executable</script>" };
```
